what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Mongolia in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3679 Mongolian asylum seekers, and South Korea hosted 49.1% of them.
After South Korea, the largest hosts are Australia, Germany and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Mongolia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 597 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7517, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
